description: buildStatusViewLayout golden vectors: for each case, buildStatusViewLayout(input) must deep-equal expected.

cases.name: focus-order-expired-snooze-floats-to-top
cases.description: Expired snoozes lead Focus, latest wake-up first, and read as unread; keyed rows follow by key, then rows without orderKey by id.

cases.name: seven-day-auto-settle-and-restore
cases.description: Seven quiet days settle a row unless it is working or was restored to Focus since; an explicit settle holds until a newer message. nextChangeAt is the earliest coming auto-settle.

cases.name: waiting-permission-overrides-later-and-settled
cases.description: A conversation waiting for a permission approval stays in Focus whatever its snooze or settle state; the snooze still schedules a change.

cases.name: later-order-and-countdown-field
cases.description: Later sorts by wake-up ascending and only Later rows carry snoozedUntil; nextChangeAt is the soonest wake-up.

cases.name: opener-and-children-across-tiers
cases.description: An opened conversation nests under its opener only in the same tier; a grandchild attaches to the topmost visible opener; a child in another tier stands alone there.

cases.name: pinned-sections-deleted-section-and-hidden-counts
cases.description: Default section first, then sections by key; keyed rows by key, unkeyed by activity; a row naming a deleted section shows in the default one; an opened row follows its pinned opener; scope-hidden counts fold unknown sections into the default.

cases.name: pinned-sections-not-loaded
cases.description: Before the section rows are read, a row naming a section is held back rather than shown in the default section, and no hidden counts are reported.

cases.name: read-only-rows-and-sections
cases.description: Permissions pass through per row; a read-only member manages no sections; an empty Focus is still present.

cases.name: placed-woken-row-keeps-unread-at-its-place
cases.description: A woken row placed by a Focus reorder (focusRestoredAt at its wake-up, expired snoozedUntil kept) orders by its key and stays unread; an unplaced woken row still floats.

cases.name: placed-woken-row-read-clears-unread
cases.description: Opening the placed row moves the read receipt past its wake-up and clears unread.

cases.name: placed-row-re-snoozed-floats-again
cases.description: A placed row snoozed again wakes past its earlier placement, so it floats to the top again.
